About

Organisme is the third album from Danish drummer and composer Antonio Dayyani and it sees his sextet returning to the studio after an extended period touring as a group across Europe. The record combines jazz with influences from rock, americana, and beyond to create a pleasantly varied output that’s glued together by the band’s connection. Dayyani stands strong as one of Denmark’s finest young Bandleaders and this album speaks volumes of his ability to compose accomplished tunes and bring them to life.
